salt: Mizan R6 independently reserved source families 2026-11-24 v1
custody: Select before running any current detector. Model authors receive no labels or outcomes until their model, operating rule and inputs are committed. No individual text or output goes to a remote scoring service.

primary.ar: Exactly 128 human original ZAEBUC essays, at most one per learner, plus 128 native Arabic Fanar-1-9B-Instruct educational free-text answers, at most one per question. Different genres and lengths. Class-conditional results take precedence over combined metrics.
primary.en: Exactly 128 author-labelled original human abstracts and 128 GPT-written abstracts generated from the corresponding paper title, sharing the same 128 HSS paper IDs in GPABenchmark Task 1. Authors and pretraining membership are unknown.

secondary: Arabic ARATECT up to 64 documents per class for a same-resource comparison. Underlying reference source may overlap earlier Arabic news cohorts and the per-document generator is unspecified. English ZAEBUC sample up to 76 unique university learners, reconstructed tokenized English from author's sample (already morphologically annotated). Report separately from the original Arabic learner documents. Up to 24 Fanar short answers of 12–47 words measure abstention under a real length shift.
transformations: Use 20 fresh parent pairs per language for controlled 25, 50 and 75 percent configurations each, with four blocks of 20 words, requiring >=60 words on both parents. Word count and UTF-16 offsets are independently checked with the product tokenizer. Consecutive source substrings and balanced cyclic placements; Arabic donors are unmatched genres, English donors share a paper title. Same donor at three mixture levels. Separate edited challenge uses 32 new English GPT-POL HSS abstracts and their human originals and 32 Arabic native-speaker edited dialectal cultural QA and their corresponding unedited versions. Only changed answers included; no assumed fraction or pure binary ground truth for edited texts. Retain natural short inputs and report abstention.
selection: Derive fixed order by SHA256(salt|role|opaque source ID), independent of model. Primary and secondary eligible inputs have >=48 word tokens and >=70% intended-script tokens. Use one parent ID per source and a different parent between pure, mixed, and edited. Short-answer length control uses 12–47 tokens. Exhaustion results in a stated smaller sample. QCRI edited example retains nonblank original and revised answers and is unique by underlying question shared across dialects. English ZAEBUC ID may also occur in Arabic, report cross-language pairing.
antiLeakage: Before inference, compare normalized exact hashes and five fixed 16-word anchors to the local corpora for deployed HL3, HL6/HL7, active R6 candidate and the archived R5 blind, source-author, and mixed cohorts. One exact or two distinct anchors found anywhere in one earlier document reject that donor. Within the new panel reject duplicate parent hashes and near-duplicates except the planned paired, polished, and related comparison variants. Exact historical author-level overlap cannot be verified where rosters are not published. This test is separate from neural pretraining; its corpus may be opaque.
metrics: Show human numeric nonzero versus all positive alerts including *%; class counts, coverage, abstention by class, TP/FP/FN/TN conditional on analyzed cases and deployed intention-to-score missed/flag rates; Wilson two-sided 95% intervals for proportions. Paired bootstrap by paper or donor for F1 and mixture mean error. Fully generated accuracy is not identical to estimation of mixed proportion. On visible numeric percentages compute proportion errors; *% lies in [0,20) and withheld values have no estimate. Publish partial-identification bounds for all outputs including abstentions. Visible flagged word spans are tested against exact donor truth using token precision/recall/IoU, and words are never treated as independent documents. Neural classifiers have no provenance percentage unless they actually output a proportion; a decision probability is not a proportion.
neuralSubset: Prespecified shared classifier panel is the entire primary set, 128+128 per language. No frozen neural-model probability is presented as a percentage of generated content.
decision: No change may enter production on improved false-positive rate alone. Compare both recall and false-positive confidence limits with the unchanged control separately by language. A Wilson 95% upper bound below 1% is required to certify the human false-alarm target. Multiple comparisons are descriptive; independent university custody, additional pure generators, genre-matched Arabic university writing, and known external author splits remain necessary.
